Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling dark fantasy training dummy animation sprite sheet, new original transparent PNG.
Primary request: Create an exquisite ironwood practice sentinel, a visibly artificial mechanical training target with eight coherent animation poses. It is a compact iron-and-wood construct, NOT a human, not a living warrior, not a simple scarecrow. Its head is a small faceless carved metal target-mask with a narrow teal slit, thick articulated blocklike ironwood torso with a glowing turquoise magical core set in a concentric antique-gold chest ring. Shoulders have layered dark gold riveted plates, weathered leather impact pads strapped directly over ironwood on the sides, exposed wooden grain and iron hinge joints. Short weighted wooden forearms with blunt impact blocks. Two squat mechanical ironwood legs terminate in broad iron hoof-feet. Strong readable silhouette and premium hand-painted texture at game size.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent alpha background. No background color, no rectangular tile, no ground plane, no cast-shadow haze, no checkerboard, no labels.
Composition/framing: landscape sprite sheet preferably 1536 by 1024, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 isolated full-body poses in reading order. Planned equal cells are 384 by 512. Each sentinel fits comfortably inside its own cell with at least 45px clear transparent gutter from adjacent poses; never overlap. All poses show the SAME construct, same armor/core/wood details, same scale and identical camera. 3/4 SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, appropriate to a 2D side-scroller. Avoid front view. Upright idle natural body height around 330 pixels; feet sit around local y 440 in each row, foot midpoint around local x192, keeping stable planted feet. Bottom row shares the same local ground baseline.
FRAME 0 top-left: neutral idle; slight forward readiness, solid feet planted, arms at sides, teal core low glow.
FRAME 1: subtle breathing/hinge settle; chest expands a tiny amount and shoulders lift slightly, same feet and same body proportions.
FRAME 2: light hit reaction; shoulders compress inward, torso dips forward a little, small wood splinters near shoulder, stable feet. Clear change without a huge flash.
FRAME 3: heavy hit reaction; solid base feet remain planted while upper torso recoils backward to LEFT about 20 degrees, mechanical spine hinge visible and one arm swings outward; core brighter. This is a strong sideways impact read, not a walking step.
FRAME 4 bottom-left: core stress; same planted neutral stance, chest core emits bright fine teal crack-lines spreading through metal/wood, a few very small sparks. All anatomy remains visible and same scale.
FRAME 5: rebound; torso leans forward to RIGHT slightly after recoil, shoulders returning, elbows spring back, solid feet anchor stays.
FRAME 6: break-down; upper body has collapsed sideways onto LEFT close to the planted mechanical foot base, separated ironwood plates and a few splinters below midheight, cracked dim core visible; pieces stay contained in its cell. This is a nonliving mechanism breaking apart, no gore.
FRAME 7 bottom-right: magical repair; construct is mostly upright again, separated shoulder/arm plates returning near their original joints with short teal repair strands, chest ring resealed, feet planted at same baseline; reads as reassembling the same sentinel.
Style/medium: premium 2D hand-painted dark fantasy game sprite, matching antique gold and dark teal settings/pause artwork. Crisp silhouette, broad material masses and engraved detail. No realistic human proportions, no human face, no fabric outfit, no soft plush or cute chibi style, no flat geometric placeholder.
Lighting/mood: controlled painted top-left light, warm antique gold edges, cooler dark teal core, deep ironwood brown and oxidized charcoal iron.
Constraints: exactly eight poses, no extra entities; all head, arms, feet, debris and magical effects fully contained with padding. Same character scale through poses, no automatic enlargement of dramatic frames. Transparent pixels around each frame, no grid lines or text.
